lines.cap: In the early 1980s, Escobar built a private zoo at his ranch, Hacienda Nápoles. Giraffes, zebras, elephants. And four hippos.

lines.cap: In 1993, Escobar was killed. The government took most of the animals away. The hippos? Too big, too angry. They stayed.

lines.cap: They loved Colombia. Warm rivers, no predators, no drought. So they did what hippos do.

lines.cap: Four became dozens. Now there are well over a hundred and fifty. Scientists warn it could be over a thousand within twenty years.

lines.cap: Hippos kill more people in Africa than lions do. And now fishermen in Colombia meet them in the river.

lines.cap: In 2023, Colombia announced a plan. Sterilise some, move some, and as a last resort, cull some. Even India and Mexico offered to take them.
